# libxml2 / xpath

libxml2's own fuzz target `xpath` ([source](source/xpath.c), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over libxml2 (gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/libxml2 at c6324894).

Checks one property, an API contract: OOM reporting contract for xmlXPathContextSetCache and xmlXPtrEval (lastError.code == XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY iff an injected failure occurred). The document is parsed before injection is armed.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against libxml2 at commit c6324894.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- OOM reporting contract for xmlXPathContextSetCache and xmlXPtrEval (lastError.code == XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY iff an injected failure occurred). The document is parsed before injection is armed ([lines 56-61](source/xpath.c#L56-L61)): abort(); confirmed in the binary.

A failed check marked as ending the process contradicts every halts statement below, so a proof of one implies it on every input it covers.

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.
